claim_ceiling: Corpus discovery, repository-scoped classification, explicit quarantine and evidence-lineage accounting only; registry closure does not establish mathematical proof, external truth, novelty, peer review or replication.
authority_rule: Task 98-99 human-adjudicated function identities override automated non-function discovery where a claim depends on a corrected function asset.
closure_rule: Every reproducibly discovered candidate maps to exactly one canonical claim and ends in an explicit disposition; unresolved items close registry accounting only by explicit quarantine.
